answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake locked for a full epoch, like water held in a lagoon: creating thousands of fake identities gets expensive because each one ties up real funds. Add slow, verifiable proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware attestation, so a gale of cheap clones cannot flood the network for free. Reputation then accrues only to identities with a long, costly history, a mesa that takes time to climb, so a fresh Sybil army starts at the bottom with no trust and no payout.
